# PSO GC disc catalogue — GPOE8P (USA, Episode I&II)

Source GCZ: `/mnt/gbox/hyperspin/Arcade/collections/Nintendo GameCube/roms/Phantasy Star Online Episode I & II (USA).gcz` (1,181,489,349 bytes, GCZ-compressed; uncompressed file total 1,406,918,978 bytes). Game ID **GPOE8P**.

## Verification (request #9182)

- **method**: In-place GCZ walk via gbox/gcdisc.py GCDisc (FST @328192, 3516 entries); format parsers from gbox/pso_gc.py (gsl_entries/bml_files/afs); first16 measured in place per file.
- **file_set**: EXACT vs FST: 3470 files, 0 missing, 0 extra, 0 size mismatches; total 1406918978 bytes
- **first16**: all 3470 entries measured; 5/5 re-verified in place in a later run (ADVR.adx, bm_butterfly_lobby.bml, gsl_aancient01.gsl, n_B01_e_body.GVM, map_vs01_02ad.dat)
- format checks:
  - **GVM**: 343/343
  - **AFS**: 32/32
  - **GSL**: 49/49 full parse (3055 entries)
  - **BML**: 292/293 header parse
  - **REL**: 0/647 raw table (PRS-compressed per docs)
  - **NJ**: 0/198 NJTL (undetermined)
  - **DOL**: 0/5 (undetermined)
- **readonly**: all checks are read-only on the GCZ; operator PC untouched

## Format classification

### REL
647 files. Raw REL section table (n,so @0x0C per gbox/gcdisc.rel_sections) not found in 646/647 sampled; AdEnding.rel carries a text comment banner ('#PHANTASY STAR ONLINE EPISODE < & >'); per gbox/pso_gc.py docs these are PRS-compressed REL modules. UNDETERMINED: resolver = PRS decompilation + per-file REL header scan.

### DAT
254 files. No content-codec magic documented in repo (PSOV2/PRS/binary per file). UNDETERMINED: resolver = PSOV2/PRS codec docs.

### BML
293 files; 292/293 BE header table parsed (gbox.pso_gc.bml_files = pso_player BE layout). fe_obj_hira_kage.bml (625632 B) final entry points 20 B past EOF (trailing padding/malformed table).

### GVM
343/343 verified GVMH magic in first 4 bytes (measured in place).

### AFS
32/32 table parsed (gbox.pso_gc.afs, LE table).

### GSL
51 files (49 top-level gsl_* + itempt.gsl + itemrt.gsl). All 49 top-level packs fully parsed: 3055 entries, all offsets+sizes in bounds, per-entry first16 measured. itempt/itemrt pending (item tables, not map areas).

### NJ
198 files; 0/198 NJTL magic in first 16 bytes -> NJTL assumption from pso_gc docstring does NOT hold for this version. UNDETERMINED: resolver = NJ decompressor from a working decomp toolchain.

### DOL
5 files; 0/5 DOL\0 magic in first 16 bytes; main.dol is an SDK loader stub per pso_gc docs. UNDETERMINED: resolver = full DOL header parse.

### PNG
321 files (PNG magic).  BMP 112, ADX 111, HTML/HTM 173, BIN 482, TPL 2, PRS 52, and 36 other singletons (see ext census).
